definition: Arria NLG plc is a New Zealand-based company with headquarters in the US.
details: Arria offers artificial intelligence technology in data analytics and information delivery. It is one of the companies in the space of automatic text generation, with a focus on Natural Language Generation (NLG). When it floated on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) in December 2013, it was valued at over £160 million. However, Arria was later delisted from the stock exchange. Subsequently, Arria has raised over US$100 million from private sources. Arria's technology is based on three decades of scientific research in the field of Natural Language Generation (NLG).

explainer.lead: Arria NLG is a New Zealand-based company, headquartered in the US, that develops artificial-intelligence technology for data analytics and information delivery. Its focus on natural language generation matters because automatically produced text can help deliver analytical information to readers.

tiers.eli5: Arria NLG is a company that works on turning information into writing automatically. It is a bit like having a helper read analytical results and write a summary for you. Its work is part of natural language generation, which means using computers to produce text.
tiers.practitioner: Arria's technology is applied where data analytics or other information needs to be delivered through automatically generated text. Treat Arria NLG as a company offering natural-language-generation technology, not as the name of a general algorithm, programming library, or benchmark.
tiers.paperLevel: Arria NLG plc is an organization working in natural language generation (NLG), the automatic generation of text, with applications in data analytics and information delivery. The company describes its technology as based on three decades of scientific research in NLG; its technical scope is therefore defined at the field and application level rather than by a named model or equation.

explainer.example: An analytics application could use Arria's natural-language-generation technology to turn analytical results into an automatically written summary for the reader.
